note: Phase 18 - the remaining fourteen pedagogic renderers, and still not one line of content. teach.py gains skeleton, bridge, signpost, anatomy, decide, listenmap, taskread, langbank, ladder, matrix, unitmap, clock, tracker and timeline, bringing the family to twenty; book.py dispatches all twenty; gate12 learns what each renderer is allowed to claim it teaches, so a word-family table cannot declare it teaches data and a bridge cannot declare it teaches a process. teachdemo.py renders all twenty at real Unit 21 lengths - 380 fitted runs of text - and gate 6 and gate 8 pass on every one.
